SELECT a.*, e.name as employee_name, e.employee_no, d.unit_name as dept_name FROM hr_mobile_approver a LEFT JOIN hr_employee e ON a.employee_id = e.id LEFT JOIN org_unit d ON e.dept_id = d.id WHERE 1 = 1
AND e.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{employeeName}, '%')
AND e.employee_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{employeeNo}, '%')
ORDER BY a.created_time DESC
